R3B-duck-drive-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 10.4 ha, 20 m from the road.
About 17 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside North Thompson River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 574 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: Private land 410 m NW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Hwy 5 30 m SE: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 3. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 41 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Cedar St, Hwy 5.
Park: 51.8208, -119.28848, pull off on Hwy 5 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 30 m NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-41, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.

plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 43 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.81053, -119.25314, where the truck road ends (V3200.98); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.2 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 30 m W, climb about 2 m.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-41, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 20 to Oct 31 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
